conventions.lines: 1-based; str.splitlines() of the text without a leading BOM (read_span's numbering)
conventions.lines_order: path by bytes, then line: scan's order over one root
conventions.offsets: literal questions: [start, end) code points into the line, non-overlapping, leftmost first
conventions.expect_re: regex questions: the generator's own Python pattern; {W} is the analyser's word code points, {NW} the rest
conventions.case_applied: what smart resolves to: insensitive unless a code point the pattern writes changes under the simple fold
conventions.grep: args and pattern for grep -rn over a copy of the folder with LC_ALL=C; or the reason grep cannot answer the same way
conventions.frozen: fixtures/text-search/exact-string-digests.json holds a sha256 per question over id, kind, question, request, expect_re, grep and expect

number.what: numbers with punctuation: amounts, dates, phone numbers, durations

quoted.what: exact phrases with stop words and punctuation, as a person would quote them

whole-word.what: whole_word on and off, and what a word code point is

no-answer.what: near misses that occur nowhere; the answer is no line
